results.title: Tamil Nadu: Udhayanidhi Stalin booked for allegedly involving minor in poll campaign for Dharapuram by-election
results.description: Tiruppur District Police on Sunday registered a case against Tamil Nadu Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin for allegedly involving a minor in an election campaign for the Dharapuram by-election According to police during a campaign meeting near the Periyar statue in Dharapuram town a day earlier Udhayanidhi made a minor boy get onto a campaign van and made him speak While speaking the boy made remarks against Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay saying Om Kali Bhadra Kali
